title: Spending Habits
blurb: Find the leaks and beat impulse buys.
cards: A daily 4 coffee is about 120 a month. Small, repeated costs are called leaks. You do not have to cut them all, just choose which ones are worth it.
Which spending is the hardest to notice?
Tiny regular costs hide in plain sight.
A subscription you never use still costs you money.
Cancel anything you have not used in a month. You can always rejoin.
For any non-essential purchase, wait a day before buying. Impulse fades faster than you think, and many wants simply disappear.
You see shoes on sale and want them now. What does the 24-hour rule suggest?
Buy immediately before the sale ends
Wait a day and decide with a clear head
A pause separates real needs from impulse.
Would I buy this at full price
A discount on something you do not need is still a spend.
example: A $4 snack bought five days a week for four weeks is about $80 a month. You can decide whether that habit is worth keeping once you see the total.
